name: strafe-desktop
description: Strafe as a native app for Windows, macOS and Linux (Tauri 2)

scripts.setup:linux: npm ci --prefix web && npm ci --prefix electron
scripts.linux:build: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix electron run build
scripts.icons: python3 branding/make-icons.py && tauri icon branding/icon-1024.png -o src-tauri/icons && npm run icons:linux
scripts.icons:linux: cd src-tauri/icons && cp 32x32.png 64x64.png 128x128.png ../../electron/build/icons/ && cp 128x128@2x.png ../../electron/build/icons/256x256.png && cp icon.png ../../electron/build/icons/512x512.png
